newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains mixed in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains mixed in quiet trading.

text.p: UK cash grain prices were mixed on Friday on a quiet market.
The market will be closed on Monday May 5 for the May Day holiday and reopens on Tuesday May 9.
Fob values were 0.50 stg down while delivered levels were unchanged to 0.50 stg up.
"There are not many old crop sellers about and new crop is a weather market," said one broker.
Brokers said the market had mostly followed the currency which started lower following the result of the U.K. general election, but later recovered.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein in the Midlands traded at 113.50 stg for May and 114.50 stg for June.
Feed wheat in East Anglia fetched 95.50 stg for May and 101.50 stg for Oct/Dec while 93 stg was paid for feed barley in the same area.
No business was reported on the fob market where values were 0.50 stg down.
